intro: Across 31 articles published between 13 April and 21 October 2026, ZCyberNews coverage tagged threat-intelligence spans activity attributed to ClickFix, Commercial Surveillance Vendors, and GopherWhisper. Reporting references CVE-2020-3259, CVE-2023-20269, CVE-2023-27532, CVE-2024-40711, and CVE-2024-40766. Affected sectors include government, technology, financial services, businesses, and civil society, while the regions covered are Global, Europe, United Kingdom, United States, and Asia. The severity mix comprises 12 high, 12 informational, and 3 medium items.
